title: Audit log
description: Tamper-evident record of every security event and change.
toggleDetails: Show or hide details of entry {id}

filters.ipInvalid: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.

verify.description: Each entry is chained to the previous one with a SHA-256 hash. Verification recomputes the whole chain to detect edited or deleted entries.
verify.ok: {count, plural, one {{formatted} entry verified} other {{formatted} entries verified}} — no tampering detected.
verify.broken: The chain breaks at entry #{id} (after {checked} valid entries).
verify.brokenHint: Administrators have been alerted. Do not modify the database; contact the system owner.
